verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Omarchy ships as a downloadable ISO that is booted to perform installation (e.g. 'takes over your whole computer when you boot the ISO and install it'), implying standard USB-based install media is used, but there is no first-party documentation describing how to create the bootable USB stick itself. missing for 10: official docs on writing the ISO to USB (e.g. via dd/Rufus/Etcher), verification steps, or a dedicated installer guide.
